module "S3_SharedConversion.dss"

product 0 Material "M_S3_SharedConversion" backend=Graph
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.8, 0.1, 0.1), ParameterName="Albedo", SortPriority=0) : float4 @L4:C1 "Albedo"
  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L4:C1 "Rough"
  %2 = Constant(Value=(1)) : float @L8:C69 "Rough"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(0.9)) : float @L8:C86 "Rough"
  %4 = Reflected[MetalnessToDiffuseAlbedoF0](BaseColor=%1, Metallic=%2) : [DiffuseAlbedo:float3, F0:float3] @L8:C23 "Rough"
  %5 = Reflected[Slab](Roughness=%3, DiffuseAlbedo=%4, F0=%4#1) : Substrate @L8:C23 "Rough"
  %6 = Constant(Value=(0.1)) : float @L9:C87 "Smooth"
  %7 = Reflected[Slab](Roughness=%6, DiffuseAlbedo=%4, F0=%4#1) : Substrate @L9:C24 "Smooth"
  %8 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L10:C43 "FrontMaterial"
  %9 = Reflected[HorizontalMixing](Background=%5, Foreground=%7, Mix=%8) : Substrate @L10:C23 "FrontMaterial"
  %10 = MaterialSink(FrontMaterial=%9) @L6:C1
  sink %10
